notes: The opening «قال وقال الليث» is a transmission verb plus Layth; the first «قال» is not a link.
«أن أبا الأسود، أخبره عروة» gives Abu al-Aswad as the one Sa'id had it from, and Urwa as the one Abu al-Aswad had it from (rule 5).
The text carries no compiler's-shaykh name before Layth; none is added.
